words_to_learn.definition_vi: một cách chính xác, chuẩn xác, không sai sót

examples.en: To gauge these figures accurately, we first need to get some facts from the shipping department.
examples.vi: Để đánh giá chính xác những con số này, trước tiên chúng ta cần lấy một số dữ kiện từ bộ phận vận chuyển.

examples.en: The container company must balance the load accurately or there could be a disaster at sea.
examples.vi: Công ty tàu chở hàng container phải cân bằng tải trọng một cách chính xác nếu không có thể xảy ra thảm họa trên biển.

word_family.example: His firm was well known for its accuracy in predicting how long shipping would take.
Don’t forget to keep accurate records; you will need them when you have your annual inventory.
The in-depth shipping records made it possible for Max to accurately estimate when the mixing bowls would arrive in the store.

structures: accurately + V / V + O + accurately (làm việc gì một cách chính xác)
usage.tip: Trạng từ 'accurately' thường đứng ngay trước hoặc sau các động từ chỉ việc đo lường, dự đoán, phản ánh: 'reflect, estimate, predict, measure, record'.

extra_families.example: An inaccurate shipping address caused a three-day delivery delay.

srs_sentence.en: Before sealing the crate, please check the packing slip to ensure the contents are listed with complete _____.
srs_sentence.vi: Trước khi niêm phong thùng hàng, vui lòng kiểm tra phiếu đóng gói để đảm bảo các món hàng bên trong được liệt kê với độ chính xác tuyệt đối.

words_to_learn.definition_en: a person or business that transports passengers or goods
words_to_learn.definition_vi: hãng vận chuyển, công ty giao nhận; hãng hàng không/viễn thông

examples.en: Lou, our favorite carrier, takes extra care of our boxes marked "fragile."
examples.vi: Lou, nhân viên vận chuyển yêu thích của chúng tôi, luôn đặc biệt cẩn thận với những chiếc hộp được đánh dấu "dễ vỡ" của chúng tôi.

examples.en: Mr. Lau switched carriers in order to get a price savings on deliveries out of state.
examples.vi: Ông Lau đã chuyển đổi hãng vận chuyển để tiết kiệm chi phí cho các đơn giao hàng ra ngoài tiểu bang.

structures: via/by a commercial carrier (thông qua một hãng vận chuyển thương mại)
usage.tip: Trong TOEIC, 'carrier' thường chỉ công ty vận tải/giao hàng (shipping carrier), hãng hàng không (air carrier), hoặc nhà mạng viễn thông (wireless carrier).

extra_families.example: Our hardware store carries a full line of electrical tools.
Packages shipped via our express carrier are guaranteed to arrive by noon.
The contract stipulates that carriage charges are paid by the buyer.

srs_sentence.en: International orders are dispatched through a reliable global freight _____.
srs_sentence.pos_hint: danh từ chỉ hãng vận chuyển
srs_sentence.vi: Các đơn đặt hàng quốc tế được gửi đi thông qua một hãng vận tải hàng hóa toàn cầu đáng tin cậy.

words_to_learn.definition_en: a list or itemized display; v., to make an itemized list of
words_to_learn.definition_vi: (n) cuốn danh mục sản phẩm (ca-ta-lô); (v) lập danh mục, phân loại

examples.en: The upcoming fall catalog shows a number of items from Laos that Mr. Lau has never before been able to offer.
examples.vi: Cuốn danh mục sản phẩm mùa thu sắp tới giới thiệu một số mặt hàng từ Lào mà trước đây ông Lau chưa từng có khả năng cung cấp.

examples.en: Ellen cataloged the complaints according to severity.
examples.vi: Ellen đã phân loại các khiếu nại vào danh mục theo mức độ nghiêm trọng.

structures: browse/request a catalog (xem / yêu cầu cuốn danh mục sản phẩm)
catalog + O (lập danh mục / phân loại cái gì)
usage.tip: Có thể viết là 'catalog' (tiếng Anh Mỹ) hoặc 'catalogue' (tiếng Anh Anh); vừa là danh từ vừa là ngoại động từ.

extra_families.example: The archivist spent three months cataloging the museum's new acquisitions.
You can view our complete spring catalog on our website.
All cataloged spare parts are stored in the north warehouse.

srs_sentence.en: The museum's newly acquired artifacts are being _____ by a team of historians before going on display.
srs_sentence.pos_hint: động từ chia quá khứ phân từ (V3/ed) ở câu bị động
srs_sentence.vi: Các hiện vật mới thu thập được của bảo tàng đang được một nhóm các nhà sử học lập danh mục trước khi đưa ra trưng bày.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: hoàn thành, đáp ứng (yêu cầu/đơn hàng), thực hiện (nghĩa vụ/lời hứa)

examples.en: The engineers fulfilled a client's request for larger display screens.
examples.vi: Các kỹ sư đã đáp ứng yêu cầu của khách hàng về những màn hình hiển thị lớn hơn.

examples.en: Her expectations were so high, we knew they would be hard to fulfill.
examples.vi: Kỳ vọng của bà ấy cao đến mức chúng tôi biết rằng sẽ rất khó để đáp ứng được.

word_family.example: We take pride in fulfilling customers' unusual requests.
Fulfilling the requirement of the contract will necessitate hiring extra staff.
Fulfillment of duties can be tedious, but job satisfaction demands attention to detail.

structures: fulfill + an order/request/requirement/obligation/promise (thực hiện đơn hàng / đáp ứng yêu cầu / hoàn thành nghĩa vụ)
usage.tip: Trong thương mại điện tử và vận chuyển (Shipping), 'order fulfillment / fulfillment center' có nghĩa là việc xử lý & hoàn tất đơn hàng / trung tâm hoàn tất đơn hàng.

extra_families.example: All fulfilled orders are scanned before leaving the loading dock.

srs_sentence.en: To speed up delivery times, the online retailer opened a new regional _____ center in Ohio.
srs_sentence.vi: Để rút ngắn thời gian giao hàng, nhà bán lẻ trực tuyến đã mở một trung tâm xử lý đơn hàng khu vực mới tại Ohio.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: thiết yếu, không thể tách rời, tối quan trọng

examples.en: Good customer relations is an integral component of any business.
examples.vi: Quan hệ khách hàng tốt là một yếu tố thiết yếu không thể tách rời của bất kỳ doanh nghiệp nào.

examples.en: A dependable stream of inventory is integral to reliable shipping of orders.
examples.vi: Nguồn hàng tồn kho ổn định đáng tin cậy là yếu tố thiết yếu để việc giao các đơn hàng được tin cậy.

word_family.example: This paperwork is integral to our ability to track packages.
The new foreman is unable to integrate information about shipping perishables.
His full integration into the team could take weeks.

structures: be integral to + N (thiết yếu đối với cái gì)
an integral part/component of + N (một phần không thể tách rời của cái gì)
usage.tip: Gần như luôn xuất hiện trong 2 cấu trúc cố định: 'an integral part of' hoặc 'be integral to + cụm danh từ'.

extra_families.example: Quality control is integrally linked to customer satisfaction.

srs_sentence.en: The new software allows seamless _____ of our warehouse tracking and billing systems.
srs_sentence.vi: Phần mềm mới cho phép tích hợp liền mạch hệ thống theo dõi kho hàng và hệ thống thanh toán của chúng tôi.

words_to_learn.definition_en: goods in stock; an itemized record of these goods
words_to_learn.definition_vi: (n) hàng tồn kho, bảng kiểm kê hàng hóa; (v) kiểm kê kho

examples.en: The store closes one day a year so that the staff can take inventory of the stockroom.
examples.vi: Cửa hàng đóng cửa một ngày trong năm để nhân viên có thể kiểm kê hàng hóa trong kho.

examples.en: Their inventory has not changed much over the years.
examples.vi: Lượng hàng hóa lưu kho của họ không thay đổi nhiều qua các năm.

structures: take/conduct (an) inventory of + N (tiến hành kiểm kê kho hàng)
keep/have in inventory (có lưu trong kho)
usage.tip: Cụm cố định bắt buộc phải nhớ cho TOEIC: 'take inventory' (kiểm kê hàng tồn kho).

extra_families.example: Warehouse clerks inventory all incoming shipments every evening.
Our computerized system tracks inventory across twelve retail locations.
All inventoried items are tagged with a barcode sticker.

srs_sentence.en: The hardware store will close early on Sunday so staff can take _____ of the stockroom.
srs_sentence.pos_hint: danh từ trong cụm take inventory
srs_sentence.vi: Cửa hàng dụng cụ sẽ đóng cửa sớm vào Chủ nhật để nhân viên có thể kiểm kê kho hàng.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to reduce; to give less importance to

examples.en: The shipping staff minimized customer complaints by working overtime to deliver the packages quickly.
examples.vi: Nhân viên vận chuyển đã giảm thiểu khiếu nại của khách hàng bằng cách làm thêm giờ để giao các kiện hàng nhanh chóng.

examples.en: To keep the customers happy and to minimize the effect of the carrier strike, we shipped orders directly to them.
examples.vi: Để giữ cho khách hàng hài lòng và giảm thiểu tác động của cuộc đình công từ hãng vận chuyển, chúng tôi đã gửi đơn hàng trực tiếp cho họ.

word_family.example: To minimize any potential risk of injury, all workers must wear closed-toed shoes in the stockroom.
Luckily, the leak from the roof did only minimal damage to the inventory in the stockroom.
The minimum is $50; orders of less will be assessed a shipping charge.

structures: minimize + O (damage/risk/delays/disruption/costs) (giảm thiểu thiệt hại/rủi ro/chậm trễ/gián đoạn/chi phí)
usage.tip: Trái nghĩa với 'maximize'; rất hay xuất hiện trong thông báo xin lỗi khách hàng: 'to minimize inconvenience to our patrons' (để giảm thiểu sự bất tiện cho khách hàng).

extra_families.example: Production was only minimally affected by the brief power outage.

srs_sentence.en: Thanks to the protective foam packaging, the fragile glassware suffered only _____ damage in transit.
srs_sentence.vi: Nhờ lớp bao bì xốp bảo vệ, đồ thủy tinh dễ vỡ chỉ bị hư hại ở mức tối thiểu trong quá trình vận chuyển.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: có sẵn (trong kho); có mặt sẵn sàng (để hỗ trợ)

examples.en: We had too much stock on hand, so we had a summer sale.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi có quá nhiều hàng tồn kho sẵn có, vì vậy chúng tôi đã tổ chức một đợt giảm giá mùa hè.

examples.en: The new employee will be on hand if we need more help with shipping orders.
examples.vi: Nhân viên mới sẽ có mặt sẵn sàng nếu chúng ta cần thêm sự trợ giúp trong việc gửi các đơn hàng.

structures: have + sth + on hand (có sẵn cái gì để dùng ngay)
be on hand + to V (có mặt sẵn sàng tại chỗ để làm gì)
usage.tip: Dùng cho cả vật ('keep extra supplies on hand' = dự trữ sẵn vật tư) và người ('technicians will be on hand to answer questions' = kỹ thuật viên sẽ có mặt sẵn để trả lời câu hỏi).

extra_families.example: Please hand your completed customs form to the agent at the gate.
All fragile parcels are inspected by hand before shipping.
Keep your tracking number handy in case you need to check your delivery status.
The compact label printer fits handily on any shipping desk.

srs_sentence.en: Customer service representatives will be _____ throughout the conference to assist with registration.
srs_sentence.pos_hint: cụm tính từ chỉ sự có mặt sẵn sàng
srs_sentence.vi: Các nhân viên đại diện chăm sóc khách hàng sẽ có mặt sẵn sàng trong suốt hội nghị để hỗ trợ việc đăng ký.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to think of again; to retain in the memory

examples.en: I remembered the delivery clerk's name as soon as I got off the phone.
examples.vi: Tôi đã nhớ ra tên của nhân viên giao hàng ngay khi vừa cúp máy.

examples.en: I will remember the combination to the safe without writing it down.
examples.vi: Tôi sẽ nhớ mã số két sắt mà không cần phải ghi chép lại.

structures: remember + to V (nhớ phải làm gì - nhiệm vụ chưa làm)
remember + V-ing (nhớ là đã làm gì trong quá khứ)
usage.tip: Cấu trúc kinh điển: 'remember + to V' (nhớ phải làm việc gì: Please remember to attach the shipping label) khác với 'remember + V-ing' (nhớ đã làm gì).

extra_families.example: Please remember to sign the delivery confirmation receipt.
A plaque was placed in the lobby in remembrance of the company's founder.
The gala dinner was a memorable conclusion to the annual trade convention.

srs_sentence.en: Warehouse staff must remember _____ the loading bay doors before leaving at night.
srs_sentence.pos_hint: động từ nguyên mẫu có to (to V) sau remember chỉ nhiệm vụ
srs_sentence.vi: Nhân viên kho phải nhớ khóa cửa khu vực bốc dỡ hàng trước khi ra về vào buổi tối.

examples.en: Eva shipped the package carefully, since she knew the contents were made of glass.

usage.tip: Phân biệt 3 danh từ: 'shipment' (lô hàng được gửi / việc gửi hàng), 'shipping' (dịch vụ/phí vận chuyển: free shipping), và 'shipper' (người/công ty gửi hàng).

srs_sentence.en: Please ensure that all fragile items are _____ wrapped in bubble wrap before sealing the box.
srs_sentence.vi: Vui lòng đảm bảo rằng tất cả các mặt hàng dễ vỡ đều được bọc đủ kỹ bằng màng xốp hơi trước khi dán kín thùng.

words_to_learn.definition_en: stock; v., to make available for use; to provide

words_in_context.passage: Read the following passage and write the words in the blanks below. For Mr. Park's Asian housewares store, shipping is an (1) ____ part of the business. Many customers need to send their purchases to friends or relatives who live far away. Other customers, who do not live near one of his stores, shop by (2) ____ and need their orders sent by mail. (3) ____ is, of course, the process of getting goods delivered to a customer, but it is more than just getting a box in the mail. Goods must be packaged carefully to (4) ____ breakage and ensure that they arrive safely. Staff members must keep (5) ____ records of the inventory shipped, so Mr. Park knows at all times the answers to these questions: When did a box leave the store? Who was the (6) ____ who delivered it? When did it arrive at its destination? Customers will have confidence in Mr. Park's business when he can give quick and accurate answers. The shipping process must be tied to the store's (7) ____. When orders are taken, the shipping staff must know that there is (8) ____ inventory of the product on hand to (9) ____ the request. If a product is on order, the sales staff should advise the customer to expect a delay. When orders are shipped out, they must be deleted from the inventory records so Mr. Park knows exactly how many items are (10) ____ in his warehouse. It takes a good computer program to keep track of the additions and deletions to the inventory. Sales staff must (11) ____ to charge for shipping and appropriate taxes. Mr. Park must keep good records on the cost of the shipping and packing materials and other (12) ____, the cost of the carriers, and staff time to assess whether he is billing enough to cover his shipping expenses.

part7.text: Questions 19–23 refer to the following letter. April 15 Customer Service Department Fleetwood Fashions 21986 North Featherstone Avenue Hiawatha, MN Dear Customer Service, I am writing about an order I made from the Fleetwood Fashions catalog over a month ago, which I have not yet received. When I called to order two new purses and several spring shirts, the customer service representative assured me that there was sufficient inventory on hand to fulfill the order. He told me that it would be shipped before the end of the week and that I would receive it within ten days. When I still had not received the shipment after 14 days, I called the company. The customer service representative checked the ordering information on the computer, and we discovered that my address had not been accurately recorded. He promised to reship the order with my correct address and told me I would receive it within ten days. That was over two weeks ago, and I still have not received the shipment. I cannot understand this. Perhaps the carrier that you use is not reliable. In any case, I am tired of waiting for my order and would like to cancel it. I am not sure whether I will make an order from your company again. This is unfortunate since it is one of the few places that carry dresses and shoes in my size and at a reasonable price. However, this is the second time I have had a problem with an order, and I don't want this to happen again. Please cancel my order #20857631. Thank you. Sincerely, Lucinda Walker 22. The word fulfill in line 3 is closest in meaning to (A) pay for (B) complete (C) send (D) receive 23. The word carrier in line 8 is closest in meaning to (A) communication (B) employee (C) transporter (D) operator

## Shipping

Study the following definitions and examples.

1 accurately adv., correctly; without errors

a. To gauge these figures accurately, we first need to get some facts from the shipping department.

b. The container company must balance the load accurately or there could be a disaster at sea.

2. carrier n., a person or business that transports passengers or goods

a. Lou, our favorite carrier, takes extra care of our boxes marked "fragile."

b. Mr. Lau switched carriers in order to get a price savings on deliveries out of state.

3. catalog n., a list or itemized display; v., to make an itemized list of

a. The upcoming fall catalog shows a number of items from Laos that Mr. Lau has never before been able to offer.

b. Ellen cataloged the complaints according to severity.

4. fulfill v., to finish completely  
a. The engineers fulfilled a client's request for larger display screens.  
b. Her expectations were so high, we knew they would be hard to fulfill.

5. integral adj., necessary for completion

a. Good customer relations is an integral component of any business.

b. A dependable stream of inventory is integral to reliable shipping of orders.

6. inventory n., goods in stock; an itemized record of these goods a. The store closes one day a year so that the staff can take inventory of the stockroom.

b. Their inventory has not changed much over the years.

7. minimize v., to reduce; to give less importance to

a. The shipping staff minimized customer complaints by working overtime to deliver the packages quickly.

b. To keep the customers happy and to minimize the effect of the carrier strike, we shipped orders directly to them.

8. on hand adj., available

a. We had too much stock on hand, so we had a summer sale.

b. The new employee will be on hand if we need more help with shipping orders.

9. remember v., to think of again; to retain in the memory

a. I remembered the delivery clerk's name as soon as I got off the phone.

b. I will remember the combination to the safe without writing it down.

10. ship v., to transport; to send

a. Eva shipped the package carefully, since she knew the contents were made of glass.

b. Very few customers think about how their packages will be shipped, and are seldom home when the packages arrive.

11. sufficiently adv., enough

a. The boxcar was sufficiently damaged that it could not be loaded on the truck.

b. We are sufficiently organized to begin transferring the palettes tomorrow.

12. supply n., stock; v., to make available for use; to provide a. By making better use of our supplies, we can avoid ordering until next month.

b. Gerald supplied the shipping staff with enough labels to last a year.

## Part 7 Reading Comprehension

Questions 19–23 refer to the following letter.

April 15

Customer Service Department  
Fleetwood Fashions  
21986 North Featherstone Avenue  
Hiawatha, MN

Dear Customer Service,

I am writing about an order I made from the Fleetwood Fashions catalog over a month ago, which I have not yet received. When I called to order two new purses and several spring shirts, the customer service representative assured me that there was sufficient inventory on hand to fulfill the order. He told me that it would be shipped before the end of the week and that I would receive it within ten days. When I still had not received the shipment after 14 days, I called the company. The customer service representative checked the ordering information on the computer, and we discovered that my address had not been accurately recorded. He promised to reship the order with my correct address and told me I would receive it within ten days. That was over two weeks ago, and I still have not received the shipment. I cannot understand this. Perhaps the carrier that you use is not reliable. In any case, I am tired of waiting for my order and would like to cancel it. I am not sure whether I will make an order from your company again. This is unfortunate since it is one of the few places that carry dresses and shoes in my size and at a reasonable price. However, this is the second time I have had a problem with an order, and I don't want this to happen again. Please cancel my order #20857631. Thank you.

Sincerely,

Lucinda Walker
